study: V9 provider semantics and metadata-only feasibility
scope: Previously exposed recording metadata and pinned public documentation/reference code. No new fresh samples or summary outcome values used.

public_session_summary_metadata.verification: Downloaded pinned public file, verified Git blob against pinned tree, counted unique session_id values only; no decoding-result values extracted.

semantic_findings.position_coordinates: column0 x and column1 y in task-specific coordinates; physical units and screen-axis orientation are not established
semantic_findings.go_interval: zero-based start inclusive, end exclusive; movement-attempt/go periods from target changes and/or task-state signals
semantic_findings.provider_trial_target: unit(mean(target_position - cursor_position)) over 300ms after reaction time
semantic_findings.provider_feature_window: mean neural features over the same RT+300ms window
semantic_findings.v9_required_stricter_window_rule: window must be inside observed go and, for calibration, paid label interval
not_established: task identity of a selected session
cursor trajectory as independent intention ground truth
sufficient duration or trial counts for as-yet unopened fresh sessions

exposed_metadata_spot_check.method: MATLAB variable inventory and struct field names only; no signal sample analysis or unexposed tail statistics

evidence_limits: Documentation and code define geometric targets, not independently measured intention.
Public total-session counts do not guarantee trial quotas within an unopened first600s prefix.
V9 paired20ms target windows differ from provider10ms sampling and must report their endpoint offset.
No prospective closed-loop efficacy or untouched-person transfer follows from this offline study.
